DTMS Batch v0.2.0

Drag this button to your bookmarks bar:

DTMS Batch

If dragging doesn't work: right-click the bookmarks bar → Add page…, name it DTMS Batch, and paste the contents of bookmarklet.txt as the URL.

Use

  1. Log in to DTMS and open any DTMS page.
  2. Click DTMS Batch in the bookmarks bar.
  3. Type, scan or paste PC Nos. (optionally with a station code), pick a default destination.
  4. Check (read-only), review the plan, then Run.

Updating: rebuild, then replace the bookmark the same way.
